title: Effects and safety of combined corneal collagen crosslinking and intrastromal corneal ring segment treatment in patients with keratoconus: a retrospective study

groups.description: Group 1: 33 eyes of 33 patients with progressive moderate-to-severe keratoconus (inclusion Kmax 48 to below 65 D, age at least 18 years) treated in one session with femtosecond-assisted ICRS (Bioring) followed by epithelium-off cross-linking at 9 mW/cm2 for 10 minutes; retrospective, non-randomised

series.notes: mean ± SD (Statistical analysis section); unit D in the row label; per-visit n not reported; device from the Methods: corneal tomographic parameters were analysed with the Sirius (CSO) Scheimpflug tomographer; one Group 1 patient had ICRS removal at the end of the 6th month for insufficient visual recovery and the article does not state whether that eye is in the 6-month mean

exclusions.what: Group 2 (CXL first, ICRS at least 6 months later; 36 eyes) Kmax series, Table 2 column C3
exclusions.reason: the baseline is the pre-CXL measurement and the follow-up is 6 months after the later ICRS surgery, which itself was at least 6 months after CXL; the time from baseline is therefore a range (at least 12 months) that cannot be converted to an exact month

exclusions.what: P value column of Tables 1-2 and all of Table 3
exclusions.reason: p-values are not admissible as values

notes: Two standard combinations of ICRS and cross-linking compared (simultaneous vs sequential) without an investigational agent, so Group 1 is a control
Age: inclusion criterion at least 18 years with mean ± SD only and no range; 'every patient older than 18' cannot be established, so the age group is unstated

Table 2 also gives thinnest and central corneal thickness, anterior and posterior K1 and K2, topographic cylinder, symmetry indices (SIf, SIb), keratoconus vertex (KVf, KVb), RMS and asphericity (Q): thickness and other keratometry, not extracted
Table 1 gives age, sex, UCVA, BCVA and manifest refraction: not extracted
Postoperative examinations were on day 1, week 1, month 3 and month 6; only the preoperative and 6-month tomography are tabulated
